name: Ryobi RY3818
blurb: 38 cc, 18″ Ryobi: 3/8″ low-profile chain, .050″ gauge, 62 drive links — Ryobi’s own parts list says “18 in. chain (3/8LP, 62DL)”.
intro: Ryobi's parts list for the RY3818 (18 in., 38 cc) identifies the factory loop as an 18″ chain, 3/8″ low profile, 62 drive links (part 901361003) on guide bar assembly 312655001. The gauge is not printed in that list; Oregon's fit guide for its 18″ S62 chain (3/8″ low profile, .050″ gauge, 62 drive links) names the RY3818, which supplies it. The two sources agree on everything they both state.

bars.note: Ryobi parts list: 18 in. chain (3/8LP, 62DL), 901361003; bar assembly 312655001. Gauge and the Oregon equivalent come from Oregon’s S62 fit guide.
